previousEditorialRevision.scope: Technical rewrites of the descriptions and non-ability-increase effect strings of all 58 active non-SRD feats. The 17 SRD feats, two legacy archives, numeric ability-increase expressions, prerequisites, IDs and effect types remain unchanged. No mechanics change or rights clearance.

scope: Final prose pass: all 16 background introductions and 128 original optional personality prompts, all ten species introductions, six Aasimar traits, two non-SRD familiar texts, all 20 Battle Master maneuver descriptions and their reference note, plus the remaining short non-SRD spell texts. Structured mechanics preserved; SRD-derived technical reference and archival metadata explicitly retained. No rights clearance.
